selection: Four independent exact captured-candidate clips, inclusive timestamp bounds, five-second pre-roll. No resampling, synthetic frames, altered road timestamps, or corrections to classifier labels.
limitations: Manual dismissal locates suspect encounters; it is not automatic non-ego ground truth.
Each clip starts fresh applicability state; controller history and actual image inference are not replayed.
Candidate and capture-session IDs refer to different live-analysis and Panoramax subsystems.
Recorded speed-reference events are observations, not replayed inputs or expected authority outputs.
